Thanks again for taking the time earlier today - appreciate the clear context on your compliance timeline. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Scope: You asked about a full account-level RTBF (subject access + delete) for customer PII processed by Redwood inference for FinTechCo test and prod environments.
- Data categories: model inputs (prompts), generated outputs, user metadata (user_id, email hash), logs (request metadata, timestamps).
- Constraints you flagged: retention in backups (30-day snapshot retention on prod backups), multi-region residency (US-only), and audit logs required for deletion proof.

Next steps (proposed):
1) We'll send our standard RTBF workflow doc and a short ingestion/retention questionnaire for your security team to confirm exact data locations.
2) If you confirm scope = account-level purge, Redwood will provide an estimated purge timeline (online data + KV caches -> immediate, backups -> dependent on backup lifecycle).
3) We'll draft a mutual action plan and proposed dates for a pilot deletion on a non-prod snapshot.

Attached: RTBF_workflow_v2.pdf and a customer-data-deletion-form.pdf (please fill basic account identifiers so our ops team can scope the work).

If that looks right I’ll loop in Mateo on the technical deletion playbook and propose available slots for the pilot next week.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: FinTechCo RTBF / deletion workflow - post-call recap

Thanks Aisha - great questions. Tactical answers below and proposed timelines: 

- Backups: Redwood stores daily snapshots for prod that are retained for 30 days. Snapshots are account-scoped and encrypted at rest. Restores are account-scoped; however, a restore of an older snapshot would reintroduce data unless the snapshot itself is processed. For RTBF we offer two paths: 
  a) Mark-and-expunge: mark records deleted in primary and run a snapshot-processing job to purge deleted items from backups on a rolling basis (adds ~30 days depending on where the data appears in the backup chain). 
  b) Backup-rotation + legal hold: if you need guaranteed removal faster, we can coordinate a snapshot re-encryption and segmented destruction, but that requires approvals and may take longer (coord with storage provider).

- Audit artifacts: Redwood can produce an exportable audit log for deletion actions (user, operation id, timestamp, records affected) and a signed confirmation letter for your compliance team. We'll include this as part of the playbook.

- Residency: By default Redwood routes US customers to US regions only. We do not geo-replicate FinTechCo data to EU without explicit configuration. I'll include an infra artifact confirming region tags for your account.

Estimated timelines (subject to final scope):
- Online data + caches: 0-24 hours once action initiated.
- Logs & request metadata (retained for operational debugging): configurable; default 90 days, can be shortened per contract.
- Backups: up to 30 days for automatic retention window; if you require earlier physical removal we'll need to follow the backup destruction process (see options above).

Next steps: please complete the attached customer-data-deletion-form with the account IDs and a preferred target date for the pilot. If you authorize, Mateo and I can run a pilot purge on a non-prod snapshot next Wednesday and share audit artifacts.

Thanks,
--
Camila Reyes
